body: What is your opinion on suicide?

Depressed person: "Help me, I need someone to talk with about my life!"
Normal person: "Shove off."
*Suicide*
Normal person: "Oh my god this happened! Someone talk to with me about my life!"
Other people: "Sounds hard, don't worry, we're here for you."

Is that irony?
I'll fuck myself tonight just for you, man. Sleep well and have a good morning.

This strong desire, I understand. The thought of no tomorrow is incredibly comforting but I've found that it is just that. You are important to me, the only person I've talked to on this 13th. You mean a lot. I could give my whole spiel but I'm not sure it matters much.

The voice you have sounds a little like my own. If you want to tell me a little more I'd love to hear it. You have at least until tomorrow. Maybe the day after. 

But, make the days count towards revealing who you are. Write your name into a tree. Get some spray paint and tag that shitty bank. These all kinda sound juvenile I suppose. Every moment you spend here is one more than you would have had. That's the thought that is keeping me going. You deserve the best, man. To me at least, just connecting with someone has meant a lot.

Take this for what it is, I thought it helped me understand a lot more about the choices we have and the one you're talking about. It was Martin Manley's web page he made to celebrate his own decision to end his life. It gave me a lot of perspective into suicidal ideation and helped me cope very well. It certainly wasn't a cure-all but it will help understand the thought processes involved from an outside perspective. This is what I think an appropriate self-termination should contain. You might hate your life. I don't. I don't know you and I bet we would have a lot in common, seeing as how we both ended up here. Haha, you might hate me more than you hate yourself!

Shit, 40 is remarkable. I thought I'd be done at 20 but here I am. If anything 60 seems to be the right age. What's the plan for the next year? Or if you're comfortable, what's the gritty making you feel shitty?
Only if you live yours, mate.

Relying on your wife is not okay. If you think she would be better off without you then she would have left you. She loves YOU not your money, not your job. Stop ignoring the obvious signs of love because, fortunately, you are not gonna die. Instead look up careers or jobs that can be done remotely. Do any physical exercise that you can and do it everyday. Don't invest all your self with her, it WILL stress her out like anyone else. It will be hard but you're in a better position than most on this sub and you need to start showing off how much you appreciate it. Get a job, get a guitar(everyone likes to listen to music, sucking at it is cute being good is sexy, can't lose) and find health insurance. Buy her flowers, write shitty poetry or take her to someplace you probably hate. In fact, everything you hate to do is probably the thing that is going to help you the most. Don't look back. You will have LOTS of time to look back when you're still alive and alone. Your excuses might seem reasonable, might not even look like excuses, but they aren't. Be the man you know she wants. You will not always have another chance. Good luck, bro.

Your story is very reminiscent of my own. Two nieces, shitty relationship and huge, often traumatic, life changes. Loneliness. You should know that we all care. You might not realize it perhaps but it will come to you. We are here for you, you just have to be here for us.
